title: Correct Δp_x
description: Essential: Student states Δp_x = 0 with correct reasoning (x-component of velocity unchanged).

title: Correct Δp_y
description: Essential: Student states Δp_y = 2mv cos θ, showing correct handling of sign reversal for y-velocity components.

title: Momentum Theorem Application
description: Important: Student correctly applies F_y = Δp_y / Δt to find force by board on ball.

title: Newton's Third Law
description: Important: Student uses Newton's third law to find force by ball on board as negative of board-on-ball force.

title: Vector Direction Specification
description: Optional: Student explicitly states directions (e.g., along x, positive/negative y) for momentum changes and forces.

title: Sign Error in Δp_y
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly calculates Δp_y (e.g., omits sign change, gets 0 or mv cos θ).

title: Confusing Action-Reaction
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly identifies or omits Newton's third law, giving force on board as same as force on ball.
